name: task-executor
description: Implements coding-agent task files and standalone changes through TDD, with independent requirement verification.

interface.shortDescription: TDD implementation of task files and standalone changes.
interface.longDescription: Implements one to-agent-tasks task file at a time through red-green TDD and verifies requirement coverage with fresh subagents before reporting. The tdd skill runs the same red-green-refactor loop for any feature, bug fix, or untested code and ends with a mutation check.
defaultPrompt: Use the implement skill to implement the next agent task.
Implement task 02 with up to 5 verification passes.
Use the tdd skill to fix the empty email bug in submitForm.
